<Project>
    <!-- Set Version for all items built here -->
    <Import Project="Version.props" />

    <PropertyGroup>
        <Version>$(BovisVersion)</Version>
        <EnforceCodeStyleInBuild>True</EnforceCodeStyleInBuild>
        <GenerateDocumentationFile>True</GenerateDocumentationFile>
    </PropertyGroup>
    <!-- 
Remove full paths (with user info) from source path names. See: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/visualstudio/msbuild/customize-your-build?view=vs-2019#directorybuildprops-example

    https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dotnet/csharp/language-reference/compiler-options/advanced

Since PathMap will break breakpoints in local debug builds, this is only activated when publishing.
-->
    <PropertyGroup Condition="'$(PublishDir)' != ''">
        <PathMap>$(MSBuildProjectDirectory)=$(MSBuildProjectName)</PathMap>
    </PropertyGroup>
    <!-- Create a SolutionDir variable if not present 
    -->
    <PropertyGroup>
        <SolutionDir Condition="'$(SolutionDir)'==''">$(MSBuildThisFileDirectory)</SolutionDir>
        <TestDir Condition="'$(TestDir)'==''">$(MSBuildThisFileDirectory)\test</TestDir>
        <SourceDir Condition="'$(SourceDir)'==''">$(MSBuildThisFileDirectory)\src</SourceDir>
    </PropertyGroup>

    <Target Name="DumpVars" BeforeTargets="Build" Condition="'$(DumpVars)'==true">
    <!-- Dump important vars after the build 
         $ dotnet build -p:DumpVars=true
    -->
     <Message Text="---------------------------------------------" Importance="high" />
     <Message Text="Some important variables used for this build:" Importance="high" />
     <Message Text="---------------------------------------------" Importance="high" />
     <Message Text="MSBuildProjectDirectory: $(MSBuildProjectDirectory)" Importance="high" />
     <Message Text="MSBuildProjectName: $(MSBuildProjectName)" Importance="high" />
     <Message Text="MSBuildThisFileDirectory: $(MSBuildThisFileDirectory)" Importance="high" />
     <Message Text="SolutionDir: $(SolutionDir)" Importance="high" />
     <Message Text="PublishDir: $(PublishDir)" Importance="high" />
     <Message Text="PathMap: $(PathMap)" Importance="high" />
     <Message Text="Configuration: $(Configuration)" Importance="high" />    
     <Message Text="TestDir: $(TestDir)" Importance="high" />    
     <Message Text="SourceDir: $(SourceDir)" Importance="high" />    
     <Message Text="---------------------------------------------" Importance="high" />
    </Target>
</Project><Project>
  <PropertyGroup>
    <BovisVersion>2.1.0.1</BovisVersion>
  </PropertyGroup>
</Project>
